error_message: CSP style-src contains 'unsafe-inline'. Task requires CSP to NOT use unsafe-eval or unsafe-inline.
root_cause: The style-src directive was configured with 'unsafe-inline' to support Tailwind CSS inline styles. However, the task acceptance criteria explicitly states that CSP must not use unsafe-eval or unsafe-inline.
prevention_rule: When implementing CSP, audit every directive against the blocklist (unsafe-eval, unsafe-inline). Tailwind CSS v4+ with PostCSS does not require 'unsafe-inline' in style-src when CSS is extracted to external stylesheets during build.

details.suggested_fix: Remove 'unsafe-inline' from style-src. Change to: style-src 'self'. Next.js 16 + Tailwind v4 extracts CSS to external files, so 'unsafe-inline' is unnecessary.
